Specification: This module specifies Euclid's algorithm for computing the greatest common divisor of two positive integers between 1 and MaxNum. The file includes a PlusCal algorithm and its generated TLA+ translation, with state variables for the program counter and the algorithm variables u_ini, v_ini, u, and v. The specification checks termination under weak fairness of Next, asserts correctness of the final result using a mathematically defined GCD operator, and also includes TLC-based counting expectations for named properties.
AssumptionNames:
/\ Print(<<"Testing Euclid's algorithm on all numbers between 1 and ",
                   MaxNum>>, TRUE)
       /\ Print("Most time spent evaluating naive definition of GCD for test",
                TRUE)
IfThenElse:
IF u # 0 THEN /\ IF u < v
                      THEN /\ /\ u' = v
                              /\ v' = u
                      ELSE /\ TRUE
                           /\ UNCHANGED << u, v >>
                /\ pc' = "b"
           ELSE /\ Assert(v = GCD(u_ini, v_ini), 
                          "Failure of assertion at line 29, column 13.")
                /\ pc' = "Done"
                /\ UNCHANGED << u, v >>

IF u < v
                      THEN /\ /\ u' = v
                              /\ v' = u
                      ELSE /\ TRUE
                           /\ UNCHANGED << u, v >>
FunctionApplication:
Print(<<"Testing Euclid's algorithm on all numbers between 1 and ",
                   MaxNum>>, TRUE)

Print("Most time spent evaluating naive definition of GCD for test",
                TRUE)

Assert(v = GCD(u_ini, v_ini), 
                          "Failure of assertion at line 29, column 13.")
TupleConstructor:
<<"Testing Euclid's algorithm on all numbers between 1 and ",
                   MaxNum>>
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE i \in (1..x) \cap (1..y) :
                /\ x % i = 0 
                /\ y % i = 0
                /\ \A j \in (1..x) \cap (1..y) :
                        /\ x % j = 0 
                        /\ y % j = 0
                        => i \geq j
